title: It’s so satisfying
body: I love the emojis. It’s so nice. One thing that is bad is that I can only have one streak but it’s still good.
author: Estella biber 57

title: Great way to keep track!
body: I was pretty lax about taking my medication’s until I was able to make a game of it. This app did just the thing. I have several friends who have used it to track sobriety and it is simple and to the point. I made the purchase of the app as well. Well worth the cost.  My request for support and help was answered promptly as well. I Feel great supporting a small app developer.
author: Hypnotic1

title: Works great but not on old iPhones
body:
Feature doesn’t swipe on iPhone SE. I go to swipe and the GUI shows like it use easy but nothing moves when I swipe. Tried closing and reopening the app, same issue. So app is pointless at this point unless I want to use auto mode.

Got an iPhone 14 and everything works perfectly
author: PoeticPirate

title: Perfection in Simplicity
body: Just what I was looking for to help me build good habits!  The only things that would make it better would be the ability to change the color of the widget and the ability to add more emojis for the confetti effects.  It gives me a little dopamine rush to choose a new emoji each day!  😊
author: Whimsical Librarian

title: Awesome!!
body: This app is so convenient! It would be amazing if we had the power to change the font of the widget, as well as the color. Would that be possible?
author: Meagan hays

title: Simple and effective
body: i’ve never written a review for an app before, but this does exactly what i needed after trying several similar apps. the widget works exactly as i hoped it would and is the reason i chose this app over the other habit tracking apps. i just purchased the premium version (one time purchase 🙏) mostly out of a desire to support the dev
author: bigteejo

title: Good user experience
body: I like the simple user experience
author: Roosteranne

title: Exactly what I was looking for.
body: Lives up to its name and does what I need it to.
